mapper.select: select c.discrepancy_case_id, c.case_version as case_version_before, a.adjudication_id, x.adjudication_action_id, x.execution_version as action_version_before, c.discrepancy_type, x.action_type, parent.transfer_id as parent_transfer_id, parent.transfer_type as parent_transfer_type, parent.from_dept_id, parent.from_warehouse_id, parent.to_dept_id, parent.to_warehouse_id, c.receipt_id, ra.receipt_allocation_id, c.shipment_id, sa.allocation_id as shipment_allocation_id, receipt.target_warehouse_id, ra.item_type, ra.item_id, ra.product_id, ra.tracking_policy, ra.damaged_quantity, x.action_quantity, a.source_cost_price, x.action_amount, ra.damaged_target_balance_id as quarantine_balance_id, ra.damaged_target_lot_id as quarantine_lot_id, ra.quarantine_location_id, a.decision_fingerprint from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case c inner join inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication a on a.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and a.adjudication_id = #{adjudicationId} inner join inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_action x on x.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and x.adjudication_id = a.adjudication_id and x.adjudication_action_id = #{actionId} inner join inv_transfer_shipment_receipt receipt on receipt.receipt_id = c.receipt_id and receipt.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and receipt.transfer_id = c.transfer_id inner join inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_allocation ra on ra.receipt_allocation_id = c.receipt_allocation_id and ra.receipt_id = c.receipt_id and ra.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and ra.shipment_allocation_id = c.shipment_allocation_id inner join inv_transfer_shipment_allocation sa on sa.allocation_id = c.shipment_allocation_id and sa.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and sa.transfer_id = c.transfer_id and sa.allocation_id = ra.shipment_allocation_id inner join inv_transfer_order parent on parent.transfer_id = c.transfer_id where c.discrepancy_case_id = #{caseId} and c.case_version = #{caseVersion} and c.discrepancy_type = 'damaged' and c.discrepancy_quantity = ra.damaged_quantity and c.source_cost_price = ra.cost_price and c.discrepancy_amount = ra.damaged_cost and c.discrepancy_amount = round( c.discrepancy_quantity * c.source_cost_price, 6) and a.case_version_after <= c.case_version and a.discrepancy_type = c.discrepancy_type and a.discrepancy_quantity = c.discrepancy_quantity and a.source_cost_price = c.source_cost_price and a.discrepancy_amount = c.discrepancy_amount and a.plan_status in ( 'adjudication_planned', 'adjudication_executing') and c.status = a.plan_status and x.action_type = 'return_to_source' and x.coverage_kind = 'resolution' and x.action_quantity > 0 and x.action_quantity <= c.discrepancy_quantity and x.action_amount = round( x.action_quantity * c.source_cost_price, 6) and x.action_amount <= c.discrepancy_amount and x.execution_status = 'pending' and x.execution_version = #{actionVersion} and x.execution_effect_reference is null and ra.item_type in ('product', 'oe', 'gift') and ra.item_id > 0 and ra.tracking_policy in ('lot', 'serial') and ra.damaged_quantity > 0 and ra.damaged_target_balance_id is not null and ra.damaged_target_lot_id is not null and ra.quarantine_location_id is not null and sa.transfer_detail_id = ra.transfer_detail_id and sa.cost_price = ra.cost_price and parent.transfer_type in ( 'warehouse', 'store_return', 'cross_store') and receipt.target_warehouse_id = coalesce( nullif(parent.to_warehouse_id, 0), parent.to_dept_id) and not exists ( select 1 from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_workflow_link link where link.adjudication_action_id = x.adjudication_action_id ) and not exists ( select 1 from inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation prior where prior.adjudication_action_id = x.adjudication_action_id ) for update

select detail.detail_id, detail.transfer_id, detail.item_type, detail.item_id, detail.item_code, detail.item_name, detail.product_id, detail.product_name, detail.product_code, detail.quantity, detail.delivered_quantity, detail.received_quantity, detail.cost_price, detail.amount, detail.unit, detail.spec, detail.grade, detail.sort_order, detail.goods_condition, detail.condition_note, detail.lot_id, detail.source_location_id from inv_transfer_order child inner join inv_transfer_detail detail on detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id where child.transfer_id = #{childTransferId} and child.source_business_type = 'transfer_discrepancy_return' and child.source_business_id = #{actionId} and child.status = 'draft' and (select count(1) from inv_transfer_detail all_detail where all_detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) = 1 for update
select lot_id, lot_no, item_type, item_id, product_id, warehouse_id, source_lot_id, receipt_disposition, qc_status, lot_status from inv_inventory_lot where lot_id = #{fact.quarantineLotId} for update
select location_id, warehouse_id, location_code, location_name, location_type, sort_order, status, is_virtual from inv_warehouse_location where location_id = #{fact.quarantineLocationId} for update

select balance_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, warehouse_id, lot_id, location_id, current_quantity, locked_quantity, available_quantity, quarantine_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, version from inv_stock_balance_detail where balance_id = #{fact.quarantineBalanceId} for update

select rs.receipt_serial_id, rs.receipt_id, rs.receipt_allocation_id, rs.shipment_id, rs.shipment_allocation_id, rs.serial_id, rs.serial_no_snapshot, serial.serial_no as current_serial_no, rs.disposition, serial.item_type, serial.item_id, serial.warehouse_id as current_warehouse_id, serial.balance_id as current_balance_id, serial.lot_id as current_lot_id, serial.location_id as current_location_id, rs.status_after as receipt_status_after, serial.serial_status as current_status from inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_serial rs inner join inv_inventory_serial serial on serial.serial_id = rs.serial_id and serial.item_type = #{fact.itemType} and serial.item_id = #{fact.itemId} where rs.receipt_allocation_id = #{fact.receiptAllocationId} and rs.receipt_id = #{fact.receiptId} and rs.shipment_id = #{fact.shipmentId} and rs.shipment_allocation_id = #{fact.shipmentAllocationId} and rs.disposition = 'damaged' and rs.status_after = 'quarantine' and serial.warehouse_id = #{fact.targetWarehouseId} and serial.balance_id = #{fact.quarantineBalanceId} and serial.lot_id = #{fact.quarantineLotId} and serial.location_id = #{fact.quarantineLocationId} and serial.serial_status = 'quarantine' and not exists ( select 1 from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_damage_loss_serial used where used.receipt_serial_id = rs.receipt_serial_id or used.serial_id = rs.serial_id ) and not exists ( select 1 from inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation_serial reserved where reserved.receipt_serial_id = rs.receipt_serial_id or reserved.serial_id = rs.serial_id ) order by rs.receipt_serial_id, serial.serial_id for update
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation ( request_id, discrepancy_case_id, adjudication_id, adjudication_action_id, action_version_before, child_transfer_id, child_transfer_detail_id, reservation_round, receipt_id, receipt_allocation_id, shipment_id, shipment_allocation_id, stock_id, quarantine_balance_id, quarantine_lot_id, quarantine_location_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, tracking_policy, reserved_quantity, consumed_quantity, released_quantity, source_cost_price, reserved_amount, disposed_quantity_before, disposed_quantity_after, stock_version_before, stock_version_after, balance_version_before, balance_version_after, decision_fingerprint, status, version, operator_user_id, operator_name, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{reservation.source.requestId}, #{reservation.source.caseId}, #{reservation.source.adjudicationId}, #{reservation.source.actionId}, #{reservation.source.actionVersionBefore}, #{reservation.childTransferId}, #{reservation.childDetailId}, #{reservation.reservationRound}, #{reservation.fact.receiptId}, #{reservation.fact.receiptAllocationId}, #{reservation.fact.shipmentId}, #{reservation.fact.shipmentAllocationId}, #{reservation.stockId}, #{reservation.balanceId}, #{reservation.fact.quarantineLotId}, #{reservation.fact.quarantineLocationId}, #{reservation.source.itemType}, #{reservation.source.itemId}, #{reservation.source.productId}, #{reservation.source.trackingPolicy}, #{reservation.source.quantity}, 0.0000, 0.0000, #{reservation.source.sourceCostPrice}, #{reservation.source.amount}, #{reservation.disposedQuantityBefore}, #{reservation.disposedQuantityAfter}, #{reservation.stockVersionBefore}, #{reservation.stockVersionAfter}, #{reservation.balanceVersionBefore}, #{reservation.balanceVersionAfter}, #{reservation.source.decisionFingerprint}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{reservation.source.executorUserId}, #{reservation.source.executorName}, #{reservation.source.executorName}, #{reservation.source.createdAt}, #{reservation.source.executorName}, #{reservation.source.createdAt} )
mapper.select: select child.transfer_id, child.transfer_type, child.source_business_type, child.source_business_id, coalesce(nullif(child.from_warehouse_id, 0), child.from_dept_id) as source_location_dept_id, coalesce(nullif(child.to_warehouse_id, 0), child.to_dept_id) as target_location_dept_id, child.status, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_detail all_detail where all_detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) as detail_count, detail.item_type, detail.item_id, detail.product_id, detail.quantity as requested_quantity, detail.delivered_quantity, 'quarantine_detail' as reservation_kind, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation all_reservation where all_reservation.child_transfer_id = child.transfer_id and all_reservation.reservation_round = child.approval_round) as reservation_count, (select coalesce(sum(all_reservation.reserved_quantity), 0) from inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation all_reservation where all_reservation.child_transfer_id = child.transfer_id and all_reservation.reservation_round = child.approval_round) as reserved_quantity, reservation.status as reservation_status, reservation.consumed_quantity, reservation.released_quantity, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_shipment v2_shipment where v2_shipment.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and v2_shipment.inventory_write_version = 'V2_DETAIL') as v2_shipment_count, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_shipment legacy_shipment where legacy_shipment.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and coalesce(legacy_shipment.inventory_write_version, 'LEGACY') <> 'V2_DETAIL') as legacy_shipment_count, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_shipment_receipt receipt where receipt.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) as receipt_count, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case discrepancy where discrepancy.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and discrepancy.status <> 'resolved') as open_discrepancy_count from inv_transfer_order child inner join inv_transfer_detail detail on detail.detail_id = ( select min(first_detail.detail_id) from inv_transfer_detail first_detail where first_detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) inner join inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation reservation on reservation.quarantine_reservation_id = ( select min(first_reservation.quarantine_reservation_id) from inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation first_reservation where first_reservation.child_transfer_id = child.transfer_id and first_reservation.reservation_round = child.approval_round) where child.transfer_id = #{childTransferId} and child.source_business_type = 'transfer_discrepancy_return' and child.source_business_id = #{actionId} and child.approval_round > 0 and reservation.adjudication_action_id = #{actionId} and reservation.child_transfer_detail_id = detail.detail_id and reservation.item_type = detail.item_type and reservation.item_id = detail.item_id and reservation.quarantine_balance_id > 0 and reservation.quarantine_lot_id > 0 and reservation.quarantine_location_id > 0 and reservation.status = 'ACTIVE' and reservation.consumed_quantity = 0 and reservation.released_quantity = 0 for update
